mission: From the visible spawn, capture the mouse and follow a reproducible controller route: establish mouse-look handedness and camera-relative movement; compare straight and diagonal travel; test walk, sprint, crouch, stand, jump and landing; approach walls and corners obliquely to judge sliding and snagging; traverse the trench, steps, ledges, and the visible moving platform; use H once to judge external impulse response; then destroy and place terrain beneath, above, and beside the capsule and judge recovery. Report feel, clipping, camera/collider agreement, input latency, slope/step behavior, and any harness difficulty separately from game defects.

controls.purpose: Capture the mouse for first-person look and gameplay input

controls.input: Move the mouse left, right, up, or down

controls.purpose: Move relative to the current view
Apply one product-authored lateral impact for external-motion testing
Destroy the voxel under the crosshair
Place a grass voxel beside the face under the crosshair
Select an edit brush with radius 0, 1, or 2; each edit is one atomic world revision

notes: Judge only visible behavior reached through genuine mouse and keyboard input. Do not inspect DOM, application state, websocket data, source, or hidden readouts. A single still cannot prove motion, handedness, collision, targeting, or an edit transition. Capture the mouse first, then test Space before moving under or against the low stone wall. If pointer recapture makes a mouse edit ambiguous, use F and G once to distinguish the documented break/place commands from the focus gesture. The ordinary HUD may support observations but never replaces visible geometry. Finish with playtest_finish and include exit_interview fields for difficulties, confusing_controls, failed_approaches, blockers, confidence, and suggestions. Explicitly separate harness/control friction from game/controller defects. Classify uncertainty honestly and do not repair the product or harness.
